name: Google GTIG European-expansion worker and facilitator cluster

attribution.legal_posture: Security-vendor research finding; legal identity and adjudication remain outside the finding.

caveats: Google publishes cluster-level material; civil identities, account identifiers, domains, and victim names remain outside the publication.
GTIG attributes the 12 personas to one worker; this file records that source attribution only and keeps them separate from any named catalog profile.

statements: In late 2024, one DPRK IT worker operated at least 12 personas across Europe and the United States and sought roles particularly in European defense-industrial-base and government organizations.

The worker used fabricated references and additional controlled personas to vouch for credibility; separate investigations found personas seeking work in Germany and Portugal plus credentials for European job sites and human-capital-management platforms.

The same research described U.S. and U.K. facilitators, a corporate laptop intended for New York operating in London, resumes claiming Belgrade University degrees and Slovak residences, false-passport-broker contact information, and instructions to use a Serbian time zone.
